Bright and Practical Living Space
This 55 sqm condo on the 3rd floor brings a nice balance of comfort and style without feeling cramped. The open-concept living and kitchen area is probably where you'll spend most of your time. It's well-lit thanks to recessed ceiling lights and plenty of natural light coming through the curtained sliding glass door that leads to the balcony.
Comfort and Convenience
The living room has a patterned fabric sofa with decorative pillows, a large wall clock with golden numbers, and a mounted flat-screen TV on a wooden striped wall panel with a matching TV console. The glossy tiled floor keeps things cool and easy to maintain.
Kitchen and Dining
The kitchen is efficient and modern, featuring wood-finish cabinets, a glass backsplash, and a good range of appliances like a microwave, stainless steel refrigerator, and a front-loading washing machine built right into the cabinetry. You'll find a dining table with chairs nearby, making meal times comfortable and casual.
Outdoor Space and Views
The balcony has outdoor seating and glass railing, perfect for enjoying a cityscape view or relaxing with a breeze blowing in, helped along by the ceiling fan and standing electric fan inside. Neutral wall colors and tasteful decorative touches like plants and wall art make the whole unit inviting.
All in all, it’s a smartly laid out condo that mixes practical features with a cozy, lived-in vibe—ideal if you want something ready to move into without overspending.
